包：npm/axios 1.7.4
漏洞：CVE-2026-101904（CVE-2026-101904）
漏洞库记录：
Axios: Header Injection via Inherited headers After Minimal Interceptor
## Summary

Axios request interceptors may return a replacement config object. If an interceptor returns a plain object without an own `headers` property, `dispatchRequest()` later evaluates `config.headers` and can resolve an inherited `Object.prototype.headers` value. In a process where another vulnerability has polluted `Object.prototype.headers`, axios can send attacker-controlled headers.

Axios does not create the prototype pollution source, and the interceptor itself is trusted caller code. The vulnerable behavior is the post-interceptor axios config read that reopens a prototype-pollution gadget after earlier null-prototype config hardening.

## Impact

An attacker with a prior same-process prototype-pollution primitive can inject headers into affected axios requests when the application uses an interceptor that rebuilds config and omits headers. Depending on the target service, injected headers can affect cache behavior, conditional requests, metadata services, or application-specific authorization and routing logic.

The issue is conditional and should not be described as affecting every interceptor or every request.

## Affected Functionality

Affected:

- Request interceptor chains where an interceptor returns a new ordinary object.
- Replacement config objects that omit an own `headers` property.
- `dispatchRequest()` header normalization through `AxiosHeaders.from(config.headers)`.

Not affected:

- Requests whose interceptor preserves an own `headers` property.
- Interceptors that mutate and return the existing null-prototype config.
- Processes without prototype pollution.

## Technical Details

`lib/core/dispatchRequest.js` contains:

```js
config.headers = AxiosHeaders.from(config.headers);
```

The initial merged config is null-prototype, but an interceptor can replace it with a normal object. If that object has no own `headers`, the read can resolve `Object.prototype.headers`

vulnerable_symbols: 也许 ["axios.request", "axios.get", "axios.post", "axios.put", "axios.delete", "axios.patch", "axios.head"]。但 JSON 数组长。题目要求“哪些 API”，可以列主要。若只列 axios.request，可能不够，因为应用代码调用 axios.get 也触发。但 axios.get 是入口。为了准确，列所有快捷方法？ Axios 还有 "axios.options"? 有 axios.options? 是的 axios 有 options? 通常有 get, delete, head, options, post, put, patch, request. 但漏洞任何请求方法。列太多可能不优雅。可以写 ["axios.request"] 并在 trigger 说明发起任意请求。因为 request 是统一入口。应用代码调用 axios.get 最终调用 request，但 vulnerable_symbols 是应用代码调用入口，快捷方法也是入口。安全分析中通常列直接 API。若用户期望类似 "_.template"，这里直接 API 是 axios.get/post 等。但 “axios.request” 也是直接 API。

也许写 ["axios.request", "axios.get", "axios.post", "axios.put", "axios.delete", "axios.patch", "axios.head", "axios.options"]。但 axios.options 可能不常用。是否包括 "Axios.prototype.request"? 应用代码可调用 instance.request。可以写 ["axios.request", "Axios.prototype.request"]? 但 Axios.prototype.request 不是应用直接调用？实例方法。

题目示例：模板沙箱逃逸要写渲染不可信模板的入口（如 "SandboxedEnvironment"、"from_string"）。这里渲染入口是具体函数。对于 axios，发送请求入口是 "axios.request"。我选 ["axios.request"]。

但“应用代码要调用哪些 API 才会把外部输入送进漏洞”：外部输入是 Object.prototype.headers，应用代码调用 axios.request 不会“把外部输入送进漏洞”，而是读取全局污染。但入口是 request。可以。

再考虑 vulnerable_symbols 是否应包含 "AxiosHeaders.from"? 这是包内部函数，不是应用代码调用。题目明确不要攻击载荷里出现的函数，要应用代码调用入口。所以不。

vulnerable_symbols 是否要空？再评估。题目说“若漏洞在包的通用路径上、任何使用都可能触发，返回 []”。这里不是任何使用，需要 interceptor。所以非空。

但“应用代码要调用哪些 API 才会把外部输入送进漏洞”：如果应用代码没有直接调用 axios.request，而是调用 axios.get，也触发。若 vulnerable_symbols 只 axios.request，可能漏。但 request 是底层入口。可写 ["axios.request", "axios.get", "axios.post", "axios.put", "axios.delete", "axios.patch", "axios.head", "axios.options"]。这样更完整。但 JSON 长。是否会有误报？ axios.options 可能不存在？ Axios 有 options? 在 axios 中，axios.options 是快捷方法，发送 OPTIONS 请求。是的。还有 axios.all, spread 不相关。

如果列所有，可能被认为“应用代码调用入口”包括所有请求方法。但漏洞触发是任意请求，所以列统一入口更好。许多漏洞卡会列 "axios.request" 作为入口。我保持 ["axios.request"]。

是否应包含 "axios.interceptors.request.use"? 因为应用代码必须调用它注册 interceptor。但“把外部输入送进漏洞”不是注册。preconditions 已说明。若 vulnerable_symbols 包含 use，可能误导：调用 use 本身不触发，只有请求触发。所以不。
